title: CampusWise: College FAQ Retrieval-Augmented Generation
description: college-faq-chatbot-rag CampusWise (static console) / "College FAQ Chatbot" (Streamlit app) College FAQ RAG Chatbot — https://github.com/aishwarya-nagothu/College-FAQ-RAG-Chatbot Prospective students and staff need accurate, sourced answers about the college. A static FAQ page goes stale; a generic LLM answers from its training data and invents details. Answer questions strictly from one authoritative .docx knowledge base, always cite the sections used, and refuse rather than speculate. Applicants, students and staff asking about admissions, faculty, departments, placements and facilities; developers extending the retrieval stack. A grounded natural-language answer plus the list of knowledge
problem_solved:
College information is scattered: admission notices, faculty rosters, placement reports, hostel rules, timetables. New applicants ask the same questions every year, and human staff repeat them. Two naive fixes fail:

1. **A pure FAQ page** answers only the questions someone remembered to write down, and goes stale as soon as a policy changes.
2. **A general-purpose chatbot** answers from pretraining, producing plausible but institutionally wrong statements — wrong faculty counts, wrong packages, invented programmes.

The hard requirement is therefore **grounding**: an answer must be extractable from a single controlled document, must show its evidence, and must fail loudly (refuse) rather than fabricate when the document does not cover the question.
